kept.title: CSP unsafe-eval gated only by NODE_ENV
kept.desc: `allowUnsafeEval` defaults to `process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`, so any deployment where NODE_ENV isn't explicitly set to `"production"` (e.g. staging, misconfigured containers, `NODE_ENV=test`) will silently ship `'unsafe-eval'` in the CSP, weakening XSS mitigation without any explicit opt-in at the call site.
